headline: Bounded real-engine AI planning trials added to campaign diagnostics

changes.title: Explore real game moves three turns ahead in a new diagnostic player
changes.detail: The optional test player now forks the live engine, preserving deterministic cascade randomness, and searches up to three swaps ahead with a strict 40-simulation decision budget. Game difficulty and actual board rules are unchanged.

changes.title: Compare smarter planning against existing bots on the same stages
changes.detail: Independent controlled trials compare one-turn objective evaluation, real-engine single-turn search, three-turn planning, and at most one emergency Hammer across twelve representative campaign stages with identical daily move allowances.

changes.title: Test search integrity and preserve detailed run evidence
changes.detail: New optional suites verify reproducible RNG branching, isolated game states, wallet debits and simulator limits, while GitHub Actions saves paired outcomes and performance evidence for later difficulty investigations.
